arithmetic_reconciliation.interpretation: The 0.5992 XRP difference may reflect rounding in the source-reported 233,461,943.1 XRP inflow or a small unaccounted ledger event. The earlier 0.99904 figure compared a final AccountRoot balance with a later explorer available-balance display and was not a valid flow reconciliation. The 1 XRP base reserve explains the difference between AccountRoot and spendable balance, not the 0.5992 flow residual.
arithmetic_reconciliation.required_resolution: Sum the five exact incoming Payment delivered_amount values, all 16 outgoing delivered_amount values and fees from raw validated XRPL transaction metadata at pinned ledger indices. Do not classify the 0.5992 XRP as an inbound transfer or unexplained sale until reconciled.

binance_xrpl_redistribution.recipient_status: Bithomp transaction pages showed the six large recipients and seventh activation-only child with inbound-only histories at that capture. This is a time-bounded explorer observation, not a current raw-node account_tx result.
binance_xrpl_redistribution.sale_status: No exchange deposit, DEX swap, bridge transfer or sale was established in the captured Bithomp recipient histories.

source_independence.theft_attribution: TRM Labs and FBI corroborate the wider Binance theft attribution; they do not independently verify all nine later XRP redistribution payments.
source_independence.raw_node_verification: NOT_EXECUTED. Direct XRPLScan API access returned an access error in the web retrieval path; a container request failed at DNS resolution. No raw rippled/Clio account_tx call was completed in this run.

whale_radar_scope_correction.evidence: The page states that the tracked wallets are read on Bitcoin and Ethereum every two minutes and its methodology says balances and moves are read from those two chains. It separately says TRON, Solana, Arbitrum and Avalanche are not followed.
whale_radar_scope_correction.admissible_use: Cross-chain context for BTC/ETH portions of the Binance incident only.
whale_radar_scope_correction.prohibited_use: Do not use this page to corroborate XRP recipient inactivity, XRP redistribution, or absence of XRP movement.

hypotheses.claim: The attacker segmented stolen XRP into six large recipient accounts after activating them from the source account.
The six recipients are staging/custody wallets and may remain dormant.
hypotheses.counterevidence: The observation is stale and does not exclude subsequent movement.

hypotheses.claim: The recipients will route XRP to exchanges, DEXs or bridges for monetization.
hypotheses.counterevidence: No such route is established in the captured recipient histories.

hypotheses.claim: The 0.5992 XRP residual reflects rounding in the reported original inflow.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Exact incoming transaction metadata has not been independently summed.

hypotheses.claim: The wallet redistribution itself caused XRP spot selling.
hypotheses.counterevidence: A wallet-to-wallet Payment is custody movement; no execution or sale is shown.

binance_circle.confirmed: Circle and Binance announced a $100M strategic equity investment and a five-year USDC commercial agreement on 2026-09-22.
binance_circle.interpretation: A direct Binance-Circle relationship that may affect USDC distribution and liquidity on Binance.
binance_circle.non_claim: This does not establish Circle involvement in the Binance theft, an XRP purchase, or an XRP market impact.

issuer_controls.confirmed: TRM reported Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD freezes during the Binance incident; native XRP is not issuer-freezable.
issuer_controls.interpretation: Stablecoin issuers have token-level intervention powers that do not exist for native XRP; this changes recovery and compliance pathways, not the XRP ledger's consensus or transfer history.

coinbase_ripple_circle.confirmed: Coinbase announced RLUSD availability on its platforms on 2026-10-28; Coinbase has a substantial USDC commercial relationship with Circle; Ripple Prime is listed as a Coinbase Derivatives broker distribution partner.
coinbase_ripple_circle.unknown: No verified Coinbase-specific customer XRP collateral balance, Ripple Prime XRP contract flow or Circle-directed XRP purchase.

forecast_status.reason: The Binance event is a custody redistribution feature, not a sale. Market feeds differ in time and volume coverage. Macro events are contextual features. No verified out-of-sample XRP predictive skill or calibration is available.
